description: Conformance vectors for jwkit. Generated by conformance/gen_fixtures.go; do not edit by hand. Every implementation must produce `expect` for each token when configured with `config` and the keys in `jwks`.

cases.name: valid-rs256
cases.about: A well-formed RS256 token from the issuer.

cases.name: valid-es256
cases.about: A well-formed ES256 token from the issuer.

cases.name: valid-aud-array
cases.about: aud is an array that contains the expected audience.

cases.name: valid-aud-array-mixed-types
cases.about: Non-string aud entries are ignored, not fatal.

cases.name: valid-no-iat-no-nbf
cases.about: iat and nbf are optional.

cases.name: valid-fractional-exp
cases.about: NumericDate may have a fractional part.

cases.name: valid-exp-within-skew
cases.about: Expired 59 s ago, inside the 60 s clock skew.

cases.name: valid-nbf-within-skew
cases.about: Not valid for another 60 s, inside the clock skew.

cases.name: valid-iat-within-skew
cases.about: Issued 60 s in the future, inside the clock skew.

cases.name: valid-huge-exp
cases.about: exp far beyond any calendar (1e300) is still a finite number.

cases.name: valid-jku-x5u-ignored
cases.about: A genuine token whose header also carries jku and x5u. They must be ignored, not followed.

cases.name: valid-unknown-header-members
cases.about: Header members jwkit does not know are ignored.

cases.name: valid-no-typ
cases.about: typ is optional.

cases.name: valid-duplicate-alg-last-wins
cases.about: Duplicate header member: both JSON parsers keep the last one, RS256.

cases.name: valid-whitespace-around-json
cases.about: JSON whitespace before and after the header and payload objects.

cases.name: valid-prototype-named-claims
cases.about: Claims named __proto__ and constructor are ordinary claims.

cases.name: valid-at-size-limit
cases.about: A valid token of exactly 8192 bytes, the size limit.

cases.name: expired
cases.about: exp is an hour in the past.

cases.name: expired-es256
cases.about: The same, for an ES256 token.

cases.name: expired-at-skew-boundary
cases.about: exp + skew equals now exactly: no longer valid.

cases.name: exp-underflows-to-zero
cases.about: exp is 1e-400, which every double parser reads as 0.

cases.name: not-yet-valid
cases.about: nbf is 61 s in the future, just outside the clock skew.

cases.name: issued-in-the-future
cases.about: iat is an hour in the future.

cases.name: missing-exp
cases.about: A token without exp never expires; jwkit requires exp.

cases.name: exp-is-a-string
cases.about: exp must be a JSON number.

cases.name: exp-overflows-double
cases.about: exp is 1e400: Infinity in JavaScript, a range error in Go. Both must reject it.

cases.name: nbf-is-a-string
cases.about: nbf must be a JSON number when present.

cases.name: iat-is-null
cases.about: A present-but-null iat is not a number.

cases.name: wrong-issuer
cases.about: Signed by the right key but iss names someone else.

cases.name: missing-issuer
cases.about: No iss claim.

cases.name: issuer-is-an-array
cases.about: iss must be a string.

cases.name: issuer-trailing-slash
cases.about: Issuer comparison is exact; no URL normalisation.

cases.name: wrong-audience
cases.about: aud names a different API.

cases.name: missing-audience
cases.about: No aud claim.

cases.name: audience-array-without-ours
cases.about: aud is an array that lacks the expected audience.

cases.name: audience-is-a-number
cases.about: aud must be a string or an array.

cases.name: wrong-issuer-and-expired
cases.about: Two faults: the issuer check comes first.

cases.name: wrong-audience-and-expired
cases.about: Two faults: the audience check comes before expiry.

cases.name: claims-inside-proto-member
cases.about: The real claims are nested under __proto__; an implementation that reads through the prototype chain would accept this.

cases.name: tampered-payload
cases.about: sub changed to admin after signing.

cases.name: tampered-signature
cases.about: One bit of the signature flipped.

cases.name: tampered-header
cases.about: One header member changed after signing.

cases.name: wrong-key-same-kid
cases.about: Signed by the attacker's key but labelled with the issuer's kid.

cases.name: signature-from-another-token
cases.about: A genuine signature transplanted onto different claims.

cases.name: empty-signature
cases.about: An RS256 header with the signature removed.

cases.name: expired-and-tampered
cases.about: Two faults: the signature is checked before any claim.

cases.name: es256-header-rsa-kid
cases.about: An ES256 token whose kid names the RSA key. A key is only ever used with its own algorithm.

cases.name: rs256-header-ec-kid
cases.about: An RS256 token whose kid names the EC key.

cases.name: es256-tampered-payload
cases.about: ES256: sub changed to admin after signing.

cases.name: es256-tampered-signature
cases.about: ES256: one bit of the signature flipped.

cases.name: es256-der-signature
cases.about: A correct ECDSA signature in ASN.1 DER instead of the 64-byte r||s form JWS requires.

cases.name: es256-signature-extra-byte
cases.about: A correct r||s signature with a zero byte prepended (65 bytes).

cases.name: embedded-jwk-attacker-key
cases.about: Signed by the attacker, who helpfully embeds their own public key in the jwk header.

cases.name: jku-injection-issuer-kid
cases.about: Signed by the attacker, issuer's kid, jku pointing at the attacker's JWKS.

cases.name: x5u-injection-issuer-kid
cases.about: Signed by the attacker, issuer's kid, x5u pointing at the attacker's certificate.

cases.name: unknown-kid
cases.about: Signed by a key the issuer never published.

cases.name: jku-injection-attacker-kid
cases.about: Signed by the attacker under their own kid, with jku pointing at a JWKS that contains it.

cases.name: weak-rsa-key
cases.about: Correctly signed by a published 1024-bit RSA key. Keys under 2048 bits are never loaded.

cases.name: p384-key-for-es256
cases.about: Signed (ECDSA, SHA-256) by a published P-384 key. Only P-256 keys are loaded for ES256.

cases.name: encryption-key
cases.about: Correctly signed by a published key marked use=enc. Encryption keys are never loaded.

cases.name: key-pinned-to-ps256
cases.about: Correctly signed (RS256) by a published key whose JWK says alg=PS256. The key's own alg is respected.

cases.name: alg-none
cases.about: The classic: {"alg":"none"} and an empty signature.

cases.name: alg-none-with-kid
cases.about: alg none, naming the issuer's key.

cases.name: alg-none-mixed-case
cases.about: "nOnE": case tricks do not help.

cases.name: alg-none-with-signature
cases.about: alg none, but carrying a genuine RS256 signature for the original header.

cases.name: hs256-rsa-public-key-pem
cases.about: Algorithm confusion: HS256 keyed with the issuer's RSA public key in PEM form.

cases.name: hs256-rsa-public-key-der
cases.about: Algorithm confusion: HS256 keyed with the issuer's RSA public key in DER form.

cases.name: alg-hs384
cases.about: No HMAC algorithm is accepted.

cases.name: alg-rs384
cases.about: RS384 is not on the allow-list.

cases.name: alg-ps256
cases.about: PS256 is not on the allow-list.

cases.name: alg-es384
cases.about: ES384 is not on the allow-list.

cases.name: alg-lower-case
cases.about: "rs256": algorithm names are case-sensitive.

cases.name: alg-empty
cases.about: alg is the empty string.

cases.name: alg-missing
cases.about: No alg member at all.

cases.name: alg-is-a-number
cases.about: alg must be a string.

cases.name: alg-member-upper-case
cases.about: The member is spelled "ALG". Member names are case-sensitive, so there is no alg.

cases.name: alg-inside-proto-member
cases.about: alg and kid nested under __proto__; an implementation that reads through the prototype chain would see them.

cases.name: missing-kid
cases.about: No kid: jwkit never guesses which key to try.

cases.name: empty-kid
cases.about: kid is the empty string.

cases.name: kid-is-a-number
cases.about: kid must be a string.

cases.name: crit-header
cases.about: A crit header demands extensions jwkit does not implement (RFC 7515, 4.1.11).

cases.name: empty-token
cases.about: The empty string.

cases.name: one-segment
cases.about: No dots at all.

cases.name: two-segments
cases.about: Header and payload, no signature segment.

cases.name: four-segments
cases.about: One segment too many.

cases.name: five-segments
cases.about: Five segments: the shape of a JWE.

cases.name: only-dots
cases.about: Three empty segments.

cases.name: bearer-prefix
cases.about: The Authorization header value, "Bearer " included, passed as the token.

cases.name: leading-space
cases.about: A space before the token.

cases.name: trailing-newline
cases.about: A newline after the token.

cases.name: newline-inside-header
cases.about: A line break inside a segment. Go's base64 decoder would skip it silently.

cases.name: invalid-base64url-header
cases.about: A character outside the base64url alphabet in the header.

cases.name: invalid-base64url-payload
cases.about: A character outside the base64url alphabet in the payload.

cases.name: invalid-base64url-signature
cases.about: A character outside the base64url alphabet in the signature. Node's decoder would skip it silently.

cases.name: standard-base64-alphabet
cases.about: The signature uses '+', from the standard rather than URL-safe alphabet.

cases.name: padded-base64
cases.about: The signature carries '=' padding.

cases.name: impossible-base64-length
cases.about: A signature segment whose length is 1 mod 4, which no byte string encodes to.

cases.name: non-canonical-base64-signature
cases.about: Only the unused trailing bits of the signature's last character differ. A lenient decoder would accept this as the same, valid, signature.

cases.name: non-ascii-character
cases.about: A non-ASCII letter in the payload segment.

cases.name: header-not-json
cases.about: The header decodes to text that is not JSON.

cases.name: header-json-array
cases.about: The header is a JSON array.

cases.name: header-json-null
cases.about: The header is JSON null.

cases.name: empty-header
cases.about: The header segment is empty.

cases.name: payload-not-json
cases.about: The payload is truncated JSON.

cases.name: payload-json-string
cases.about: The payload is a JSON string, not an object.

cases.name: nested-jwt
cases.about: A correctly signed JWT whose payload is another JWT (cty "JWT"). jwkit does not unwrap nested tokens.

cases.name: payload-trailing-data
cases.about: A second JSON value after the claims object.

cases.name: payload-stray-brace
cases.about: An extra closing brace after the claims object.

cases.name: payload-invalid-utf8
cases.about: The payload contains the byte 0xFF, which is not valid UTF-8. Correctly signed.

cases.name: payload-byte-order-mark
cases.about: The payload starts with a UTF-8 byte order mark. Correctly signed. JavaScript's TextDecoder would strip it silently.

cases.name: one-byte-over-size-limit
cases.about: A correctly signed token of 8193 bytes, one over the limit.

cases.name: extremely-long-token
cases.about: A correctly signed token of roughly 64 KiB.
